'''Kor Anjiliac''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Kor Anjiliac system/Legends|Kor Anjiliac system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It was connected by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Huloon system/Legends|Huloon]] and [[Langoona system/Legends|Langoona systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Kor Anjiliac served as the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Anjiliac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kor Anjiliac was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-11.<ref name="TEA" />
